reason: No controlled cold/warm navigation, interaction-latency, long-task or memory baseline was collected, on this hardware or on the hosted target. The hosted target now exists, so this is a measurement that was not taken rather than one that could not be.
availableObservation: The local and hosted browser harnesses each completed all 43 checks with a clean console and no uncaught exception, and the hosted run recorded 4 requests with none off-site. That is evidence the page works, not evidence of how fast it is for anyone.

sizeFactsOnly.note: Byte counts are the only performance-adjacent figures this package has actually measured. Transfer size is not latency, and none of these numbers describes a user's experience.
sizeFactsOnly.gzipViteReport: zlib.gzipSync at its defaults, as Vite prints it: JS 83195 B, CSS 6077 B.
sizeFactsOnly.gzipNine: gzip -9 on the same two files: JS 81909 B, CSS 6033 B.
sizeFactsOnly.whyTwo: Two compressors at two settings give two honest numbers for the same bytes. Quote which one produced a figure whenever one is used.

requiredForRerun: The live URL: https://androlay.github.io/withheld/ — already met, so cold navigation can be measured against a real host rather than a loopback preview.
A clean browser profile and a named machine, so the sample can be attributed to hardware.
At least one device that is not the author's workstation, if a claim about ordinary hardware is ever to be made.
rerunProtocol: Measure cold and warm navigation on the hosted URL in a clean profile, at least ten samples each, and keep the raw samples.
Measure native dispatch-to-DOM-update latency separately for reads and for writes, over repeated runs, since a write recomputes every total and a read does not.
Record long tasks, and memory and lifecycle behaviour after repeated register/abort/reload cycles.
Record browser, device, network conditions, and every raw sample alongside the summary.
Report a distribution and its limitations. A single number from one machine is not a baseline, and a median from ten samples on one machine is a fact about that machine.
notClaimed: No performance target, load-time figure, latency figure, or production-scale responsiveness claim is made anywhere in this package, and none may be added while this artifact stands.
